title: The Train
desc: A police officer, Kedarnath, strives to prevent a terror attack in Mumbai that unleashes fear amongst the residents and destroys many lives.

title: Circus Car
desc: Four children wander in the forest to hunt a real ghost. Things take a terrifying turn when they come across a car possessed by a spirit.

title: Om Jai Jagadish
desc: Divided by ideologies, yet bound by love, three brothers end up going their separate ways. Fate offers them another chance to be together when their family home is on the brink of foreclosure.

title: Encounter Shankar
desc: Post his transfer to a village, an encounter specialist sets out to stop a crime boss who wants to build a power plant in the region despite strong public opposition.

title: Aliens 2042
desc: A group of survivors band together to fight extraterrestrials that have invaded Earth. Despite facing constant threats from humans and aliens alike, they are determined to reclaim the fallen planet.

title: Commando 3
desc: Commando Karan Singh Dogra and Inspector Bhavna Reddy race against time to thwart a terrorist attack on India. Later, they realise that foiling mastermind Buraq's plan is harder than it seems.
